findings: hlada-api has NEVER existed on the Cloudflare account (API code 10007) — the 2026-08-11 census assumed it was production 'conservatively', which was the wrong direction
The top-level gateway binds MAIN_APP to that non-existent Worker, so top-level config as committed cannot deploy into a working state

Top-level console last deployed 2026-04-23 and top-level gateway 2026-04-19; their secret sets are the pre-Sprint-4.5 architecture frozen in April

OB18 was giving a FALSE PASS — a 3000-character window after `async alarm(` matched a `liveness` reference in a different method ~100 lines below; fourth instance in that file of a rule matching text NEAR the thing, and the first that hid a gap rather than raising a false alarm
The dispatch's CRLF premise does not reproduce: 4 modified files not 580, none whitespace-only, and core.autocrlf is `true` at SYSTEM level rather than unset
Gap-free numbering is settled by Icelandic law ('fyrirfram tölusett … í samfelldri töluröð'), not by preference — so there is no release operation, only void-in-place
TS-236 is not an alternative to PEPPOL; it IS the Icelandic national extension of PEPPOL BIS Billing 3.0 — this removes a decision option rather than adding one
No delivery format is disqualified for the agent posture: EN 16931 BG-10 Payee (BT-59/BT-60) expresses it. PDF PERMITS the correct header; PEPPOL REQUIRES it
Per-claim bank fees may change the billing period — a single-connector host is a 200 kr invoice and the fee taxonomy charges per claim, slip, change, payment and escalation
The bank rail duns on its own (sjálfvirkar ítrekanir, framhaldsinnheimta), so Straumvakt must not also dun — hence the externally_managed dunning mode
Electronic bookkeeping requires a 'yfirlýsing seljanda eða hönnuðar hugbúnaðarins' — a signature, not code, and nobody has it on a list
Golden files caught a real header defect on their first render: 'Hýsill A ehf..' — Icelandic company names end in a full stop
blockers: Which gateway the 21 live chargers hold WebSockets against is NOT closed — a ~30s read-only tail of both gateways was empty, which at a 3600s heartbeat proves nothing. Closes with a >60min tail or the DO/WebSocket panel in the dashboard
No version_metadata binding anywhere — still the single blocking release fact, unchanged since 2026-08-11
Access-point pricing, bank per-claim fees, and the bank onboarding lead time are all unknown and were NOT guessed; each is a written blocking question
